connector.name: Hugging Bay
connector.registryDescription: Verified open AI artifact search, trust evidence, downloads, and agent workflows from Hugging Bay.
connector.summary: Hosted at huggingbay.xyz over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package hugging-bay-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the barneywohl account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HUGGING_BAY_API
env.description: Hugging Bay API base URL. Defaults to https://huggingbay.xyz.

env.name: HUGGING_BAY_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token (hb_...) enabling authenticated watchlist and publisher tools. Public read-only tools work without it.
